Elite Squadron Stormtrooper (V) is a Dark Character (Imperial) from Virtual Set 16: Revenge Of The Sith.

Card Text

Clone. Heroic. Deploys -1 if a Dark Jedi at Senate. Power +2 if with Order 66. Jedi here are Heroic. Permanent weapon is blaster rifle (may target a character or vehicle for free; draw destiny; target hit if destiny > defense value).

Lore

Commander Igar selected the Empire’s most dedicated stormtroopers to guard Endor for the Emperor. All they know is killing and white uniforms.



Sources

Strategic Reserves (V) is a Dark Effect from Virtual Set 16: Revenge Of The Sith.

Card Text

Deploy on table. Your clones and Coruscant guards are destiny +1 when drawn for weapon or battle destiny. Once per turn, may cancel a Force drain by placing here from hand a clone or Coruscant guard. Characters may deploy from here as if from hand.

Lore

The Empire is able to quickly relocate its manpower, deploying its troops as efficiently as possible.

Concussion Missiles (V) is a Dark Weapon (Starship Weapon) from Virtual Set 16: Revenge Of The Sith.

Card Text

Use 1 Force to deploy on your starfighter. May target a starship for free. Draw destiny (if on a Heroic starfighter, may first use 1 Force to add 3 to total). Target hit if total destiny > defense value.

Lore

Originally developed by smugglers and pirates as defense against starfighters. Adapted by the Empire to serve as onboard defense for slow moving bombers.

Mandalorian Armor (V) is a Dark Device from Virtual Set 16: Revenge Of The Sith.

Card Text

Deploy on your alien of ability < 4. Character gains bounty hunter skill and immunity to attrition < 4. If character just hit, may place this device in Lost Pile (Used Pile if on The Mandalorian) to restore it to normal.

Lore

Contains wrist lasers, rocket dart launchers, a flame projector, a projected grappling hook, a concussion grenade launcher, four kinds of sensors and a broad band antenna.

Wounded Wookiee (V) is a Dark Interrupt (Used Interrupt) from Virtual Set 16: Revenge Of The Sith.

Card Text

If opponent’s character was just hit during battle, add one destiny to your total power (two if character was a Wookiee); take cards drawn this way into hand. OR If you just lost X Force to a Force drain, draw up to X cards from Reserve Deck.

Lore

When blaster fire from the barge’s gun hit Chewie’s skiff, his leg was injured by shrapnel. This setback distracted the Rebels, causing them to momentarily lose their advantage.



Sources

  • VirtualCards16.pdf (Players Committee Remaster sheet, starwarsccg.org CDN) — official text as of 15 August 2008; page 9, slip 68. Slip image and game text from this sheet. Preserved copy: Internet Archive
  • Lore and art: the printed Decipher card, Wounded Wookiee.
  • Full-card remaster: Virtual Set 16: Revenge Of The Sith (fan reconstruction, 2026).
